select
    stop_id                                               as l_stop_id,
    trim(stop_name)                                       as l_station_name,
    try_to_double(stop_lat)                               as lat,
    try_to_double(stop_lon)                               as lon,
    wheelchair_boarding
from DIVVY.RAW.cta_stops_raw
where location_type = '1'
  and try_to_number(stop_id) between 40000 and 49999

with snaps as (

    select
        r.file_last_modified                              as snapshot_at,
        s.value                                           as st
    from DIVVY.RAW.station_information_raw r,
         lateral flatten(input => r.raw:data:stations) s

),

parsed as (

    select
        st:station_id::string                             as station_id,
        st:short_name::string                             as short_name,
        trim(st:name::string)                             as station_name,
        st:lat::float                                     as lat,
        st:lon::float                                     as lon,
        st:capacity::int                                  as capacity,
        st:region_id::string                              as region_id,
        st:is_virtual_station::boolean                    as is_virtual_station,
        snapshot_at
    from snaps
    where st:station_id is not null

),

latest as (

    select
        *,
        min(snapshot_at) over (partition by station_id)   as first_seen_at,
        max(snapshot_at) over (partition by station_id)   as last_seen_at
    from parsed
    qualify row_number() over (partition by station_id order by snapshot_at desc) = 1

)

select
    station_id,
    short_name,
    station_name,
    lat,
    lon,
    capacity,
    region_id,
    first_seen_at,
    last_seen_at,
    (
        station_name ilike '%public rack%'
        or station_name ilike '%corral%'
        or coalesce(is_virtual_station, false)
        or coalesce(capacity, 0) = 0
    )                                                     as is_rack_or_corral
from latest

select station_id
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_information
where station_id is null

select station_name
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_information
where station_name is null

with src as (

    select raw, file_name, loaded_at
    from DIVVY.RAW.weather_raw

),

hours as (

    select
        to_timestamp_ntz(t.value::string, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI')  as hour_utc,
        w.raw:hourly:temperature_2m[t.index]::float                as temp_c,
        w.raw:hourly:precipitation[t.index]::float                 as precip_mm,
        w.raw:hourly:rain[t.index]::float                          as rain_mm,
        w.raw:hourly:snowfall[t.index]::float                      as snow_cm,
        w.raw:hourly:wind_speed_10m[t.index]::float                as wind_kmh,
        w.raw:hourly:wind_direction_10m[t.index]::float            as wind_dir_deg,
        w.raw:hourly:weather_code[t.index]::int                    as weather_code,
        w.loaded_at
    from src w,
         lateral flatten(input => w.raw:hourly:time) t

)

select
    hour_utc, temp_c, precip_mm, rain_mm, snow_cm, wind_kmh, wind_dir_deg, weather_code
from hours
where temp_c is not null
qualify row_number() over (partition by hour_utc order by loaded_at desc) = 1

with spine as (

    select
        dateadd('hour', row_number() over (order by seq4()) - 1,
                '2020-01-01 00:00:00'::timestamp_ntz)            as hour_utc
    from table(generator(rowcount => 70128))   -- ~8 years of hours

),

local as (

    select
        hour_utc,
        convert_timezone('UTC', 'America/Chicago', hour_utc)     as hour_chicago
    from spine
    where hour_utc <= dateadd('day', 7, convert_timezone('UTC', current_timestamp())::timestamp_ntz)

),

parts as (

    select
        hour_utc,
        hour_chicago,
        to_date(hour_chicago)                                    as date_chicago,
        hour(hour_chicago)                                       as hour_of_day,
        dayofweekiso(hour_chicago)                               as day_of_week_iso,
        dayname(hour_chicago)                                    as day_name,
        month(hour_chicago)                                      as month_num,
        year(hour_chicago)                                       as year_num
    from local

)

select
    *,
    day_of_week_iso in (6, 7)                                    as is_weekend,
    case
        when day_of_week_iso <= 5 and hour_of_day between 7 and 9   then 'am_commute'
        when day_of_week_iso <= 5 and hour_of_day between 16 and 18 then 'pm_commute'
        else 'other'
    end                                                          as commute_period,
    case
        when month_num in (12, 1, 2) then 'winter'
        when month_num in (3, 4, 5)  then 'spring'
        when month_num in (6, 7, 8)  then 'summer'
        else 'fall'
    end                                                          as season
from parts

select hour_utc
from DIVVY.PROD_marts.dim_time
where hour_utc is null

select
    station_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_information
where station_id is not null
group by station_id
having count(*) > 1

select hour_utc
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_weather
where hour_utc is null

select l_stop_id
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_cta_l_stations
where l_stop_id is null

select
    hour_utc as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.PROD_marts.dim_time
where hour_utc is not null
group by hour_utc
having count(*) > 1

select
    hour_utc as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_weather
where hour_utc is not null
group by hour_utc
having count(*) > 1

select
    l_stop_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_cta_l_stations
where l_stop_id is not null
group by l_stop_id
having count(*) > 1

with stations as (

    select station_id, lat, lon
    from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_information
    where lat is not null and lon is not null

),

l_stations as (

    select l_stop_id, l_station_name, lat, lon
    from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_cta_l_stations
    where lat is not null and lon is not null

)

select
    s.station_id,
    l.l_stop_id                                           as nearest_l_stop_id,
    l.l_station_name                                      as nearest_l_station_name,
    haversine(s.lat, s.lon, l.lat, l.lon)                 as distance_to_l_km
from stations s
cross join l_stations l
qualify row_number() over (
    partition by s.station_id
    order by haversine(s.lat, s.lon, l.lat, l.lon)
) = 1

select station_id
from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_distance_to_l
where station_id is null

select
    station_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_distance_to_l
where station_id is not null
group by station_id
having count(*) > 1

with src as (

    select * from DIVVY.RAW.divvy_trips_raw

),

typed as (

    select
        ride_id,
        rideable_type,
        try_to_timestamp_ntz(started_at)                  as started_at_local,
        try_to_timestamp_ntz(ended_at)                    as ended_at_local,
        nullif(trim(start_station_id), '')                as start_station_id,
        nullif(trim(start_station_name), '')              as start_station_name,
        nullif(trim(end_station_id), '')                  as end_station_id,
        nullif(trim(end_station_name), '')                as end_station_name,
        try_to_double(start_lat)                          as start_lat,
        try_to_double(start_lng)                          as start_lng,
        try_to_double(end_lat)                            as end_lat,
        try_to_double(end_lng)                            as end_lng,
        member_casual,
        file_name,
        to_date(regexp_substr(file_name, '([0-9]{6})-divvy', 1, 1, 'e', 1), 'YYYYMM') as file_month
    from src
    where ride_id is not null

)

select
    *,
    convert_timezone('America/Chicago', 'UTC', started_at_local)   as started_at_utc,
    convert_timezone('America/Chicago', 'UTC', ended_at_local)     as ended_at_utc,
    datediff('second', started_at_local, ended_at_local)           as duration_sec,
    start_station_id is null                                       as start_off_station,
    end_station_id is null                                         as end_off_station
from typed
qualify row_number() over (partition by ride_id order by file_name) = 1

select ride_id
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_trips
where ride_id is null

select started_at_utc
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_trips
where started_at_utc is null

with snapshots as (

    select
        r.file_name,
        r.file_last_modified                              as polled_at,
        s.value                                           as st
    from DIVVY.RAW.station_status_raw r,
         lateral flatten(input => r.raw:data:stations) s
    
    where r.file_last_modified > (select max(polled_at) from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status)
    

),

parsed as (

    select
        st:station_id::string                             as station_id,
        to_timestamp_ntz(st:last_reported::int)           as last_reported_at,
        polled_at,
        file_name,

        st:num_bikes_available::int                       as bikes_available,
        st:num_ebikes_available::int                      as ebikes_available,
        st:num_bikes_disabled::int                        as bikes_disabled,
        st:num_docks_available::int                       as docks_available,
        st:num_docks_disabled::int                        as docks_disabled,

        coalesce(st:is_installed::int, 1) = 1             as is_installed,
        coalesce(st:is_renting::int,   1) = 1             as is_renting,
        coalesce(st:is_returning::int, 1) = 1             as is_returning

        from snapshots
    where st:station_id is not null
      and st:last_reported is not null
      -- some stations report a placeholder time (1970) before going live
      and to_timestamp_ntz(st:last_reported::int) >= '2020-01-01'

)

select *
from parsed
-- keep the first poll that saw each distinct station report
qualify row_number() over (
    partition by station_id, last_reported_at
    order by polled_at
) = 1

select
    file_name,
    file_month,
    count(*)                                                        as trips,
    sum(iff(date_trunc('month', started_at_local) <> file_month, 1, 0)) as off_month_trips
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_trips
group by file_name, file_month
having sum(iff(date_trunc('month', started_at_local) <> file_month, 1, 0)) > 0.01 * count(*)

select
    ride_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_trips
where ride_id is not null
group by ride_id
having count(*) > 1

select last_reported_at
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status
where last_reported_at is null

select polled_at
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status
where polled_at is null

select station_id
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status
where station_id is null

select *
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status
where bikes_available < 0
   or docks_available < 0
   or coalesce(ebikes_available, 0) < 0
   or coalesce(bikes_disabled, 0) < 0
   or coalesce(docks_disabled, 0) < 0

select bikes_available
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status
where bikes_available is null

select docks_available
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status
where docks_available is null

select station_id, last_reported_at, count(*) as n
from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status
group by station_id, last_reported_at
having count(*) > 1

with trip_ends as (

    select start_station_id as trip_station_id, start_station_name as trip_station_name
    from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_trips
    where start_station_id is not null

    union all

    select end_station_id, end_station_name
    from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_trips
    where end_station_id is not null

),

trip_stations as (

    -- one row per trip station ID, with its most common name and total endpoints
    select
        trip_station_id,
        trip_station_name,
        sum(count(*)) over (partition by trip_station_id)  as endpoint_count
    from trip_ends
    group by trip_station_id, trip_station_name
    qualify row_number() over (partition by trip_station_id order by count(*) desc) = 1

),

live as (

    select
        station_id,
        short_name,
        lower(trim(station_name))                         as name_key
    from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_information

)

select
    t.trip_station_id,
    t.trip_station_name,
    t.endpoint_count,
    coalesce(by_short.station_id, by_name.station_id)     as station_id,
    case
        when by_short.station_id is not null then 'short_name'
        when by_name.station_id  is not null then 'name'
        else 'unmatched'
    end                                                   as match_method
from trip_stations t
left join live by_short on t.trip_station_id = by_short.short_name
left join live by_name  on lower(trim(t.trip_station_name)) = by_name.name_key
qualify row_number() over (
    partition by t.trip_station_id
    order by (by_short.station_id is null), by_name.station_id
) = 1

select
    trip_station_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_crosswalk
where trip_station_id is not null
group by trip_station_id
having count(*) > 1

with info as (

    select * from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_information

),

status_only as (

    -- stations reporting status but never seen in the station_information feed
    select distinct station_id
    from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status
    where station_id not in (select station_id from info)

),

all_stations as (

    select
        station_id, short_name, station_name, lat, lon, capacity, region_id,
        is_rack_or_corral, first_seen_at, last_seen_at,
        true                                       as is_in_station_feed
    from info

    union all

    select
        station_id,
        null                                       as short_name,
        'Unknown (not in station feed)'            as station_name,
        null, null, null, null,
        false                                      as is_rack_or_corral,
        null, null,
        false                                      as is_in_station_feed
    from status_only

)
select
    a.station_id,
    a.short_name,
    a.station_name,
    a.lat,
    a.lon,
    a.capacity,
    a.region_id,
    a.is_rack_or_corral,
    a.is_in_station_feed,
    d.nearest_l_stop_id,
    d.nearest_l_station_name,
    d.distance_to_l_km,
    coalesce(d.distance_to_l_km <= 0.4, false)   as is_near_l,
    a.first_seen_at,
    a.last_seen_at
from all_stations a
left join DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_distance_to_l d
    on a.station_id = d.station_id

select trip_station_id
from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_crosswalk
where trip_station_id is null

with all_values as (

    select
        match_method as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_crosswalk
    group by match_method

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'short_name','name','unmatched'
)

select station_id
from DIVVY.PROD_marts.dim_station
where station_id is null

select
    station_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.PROD_marts.dim_station
where station_id is not null
group by station_id
having count(*) > 1

with status as (

    select * from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_status

),

info as (

    select station_id, capacity, is_rack_or_corral
    from DIVVY.PROD_staging.stg_station_information

),

latest_poll as (

    select
        max(polled_at) as max_polled_at,
        min(polled_at) as collection_start
    from status

),

ordered as (

    select
        s.station_id,
        s.last_reported_at                                            as valid_from,
        lead(s.last_reported_at) over (
            partition by s.station_id order by s.last_reported_at)    as next_report_at,
        s.bikes_available,
        s.ebikes_available,
        s.bikes_disabled,
        s.docks_available,
        s.docks_disabled,
        s.is_installed,
        s.is_renting,
        s.is_returning,
        i.capacity,
        coalesce(i.is_rack_or_corral, false)                          as is_rack_or_corral
    from status s
    left join info i on s.station_id = i.station_id

),

with_end as (

    select
        o.station_id,
        greatest(o.valid_from, lp.collection_start)                   as valid_from,
        o.valid_from < lp.collection_start                            as is_clipped,
        coalesce(o.next_report_at, lp.max_polled_at)                  as valid_to,
        o.next_report_at is null                                      as is_current,
        o.bikes_available,
        o.ebikes_available,
        o.bikes_disabled,
        o.docks_available,
        o.docks_disabled,
        o.is_installed,
        o.is_renting,
        o.is_returning,
        o.capacity,
        o.is_rack_or_corral
    from ordered o
    cross join latest_poll lp

)

select
    station_id,
    valid_from,
    valid_to,
    datediff('second', valid_from, valid_to) / 60.0                   as duration_min,
    date_trunc('hour', valid_from)                                    as hour_utc,
    bikes_available,
    ebikes_available,
    bikes_disabled,
    docks_available,
    docks_disabled,
    capacity,
    is_installed,
    is_renting,
    is_returning,
    is_rack_or_corral,
    is_current,
    is_clipped,
    datediff('second', valid_from, valid_to) / 60.0
        > 30                                  as is_stale,
    case
        when not is_installed or (not is_renting and not is_returning) then 'out_of_service'
        when bikes_available = 0 and is_renting                        then 'empty'
        when docks_available = 0 and is_returning                      then 'full'
        else 'ok'
    end                                                               as station_state
from with_end 
where valid_to > valid_from

select station_id
from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
where station_id is null

with all_values as (

    select
        station_state as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
    group by station_state

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'empty','full','ok','out_of_service'
)

with intervals as (

    select station_id, valid_from, bikes_available, hour_utc
    from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
    where not is_rack_or_corral
      and station_state <> 'out_of_service'

),

changes as (

    select
        station_id,
        lag(valid_from) over (partition by station_id order by valid_from)      as window_start,
        valid_from                                                              as window_end,
        hour_utc,
        bikes_available
          - lag(bikes_available) over (partition by station_id order by valid_from) as bike_change
    from intervals

),

candidates as (

    select *
    from changes
    where window_start is not null
      and abs(bike_change) >= 5
      and datediff('second', window_start, window_end) / 60.0 <= 10

),

with_neighbors as (

    select
        *,
        lead(bike_change) over (partition by station_id order by window_end) as next_change,
        lead(window_end)  over (partition by station_id order by window_end) as next_end,
        lag(bike_change)  over (partition by station_id order by window_end) as prev_change,
        lag(window_end)   over (partition by station_id order by window_end) as prev_end
    from candidates

),

flagged as (

    select
        *,
        -- this move is undone by the next one, or it undoes the previous one
        (
            (next_change is not null
             and sign(next_change) <> sign(bike_change)
             and abs(bike_change + next_change) <= 1
             and datediff('minute', window_end, next_end) <= 30)
         or
            (prev_change is not null
             and sign(prev_change) <> sign(bike_change)
             and abs(bike_change + prev_change) <= 1
             and datediff('minute', prev_end, window_end) <= 30)
        )                                                                     as is_flicker
    from with_neighbors

)

select
    md5(station_id || '|' || to_varchar(window_end))                 as rebalancing_event_id,
    station_id,
    window_start,
    window_end,
    hour_utc,
    datediff('second', window_start, window_end) / 60.0              as window_min,
    bike_change,
    iff(bike_change > 0, 'drop_off', 'pick_up')                      as event_type
from flagged
where not is_flicker

select
    rebalancing_event_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.PROD_marts.fct_rebalancing_events
where rebalancing_event_id is not null
group by rebalancing_event_id
having count(*) > 1

select rebalancing_event_id
from DIVVY.PROD_marts.fct_rebalancing_events
where rebalancing_event_id is null

with child as (
    select station_id as from_field
    from DIVVY.PROD_marts.fct_rebalancing_events
    where station_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select station_id as to_field
    from DIVVY.PROD_marts.dim_station
)

select
    from_field

from child
left join parent
    on child.from_field = parent.to_field

where parent.to_field is null

with intervals as (

    select *
    from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
    where not is_rack_or_corral

),

marked as (

    select
        *,
        case
            when station_state = lag(station_state) over (
                     partition by station_id order by valid_from)
            then 0 else 1
        end                                                          as is_new_island
    from intervals

),

islands as (

    select
        *,
        sum(is_new_island) over (
            partition by station_id order by valid_from
            rows between unbounded preceding and current row)        as island_id
    from marked

),

episodes as (

    select
        station_id,
        island_id,
        station_state                                                as stockout_type,
        min(valid_from)                                              as started_at,
        max(valid_to)                                                as ended_at,
        boolor_agg(is_current)                                       as is_ongoing,
        boolor_agg(is_stale)                                         as includes_stale_report,
        count(*)                                                     as report_count
    from islands
    where station_state in ('empty', 'full')
    group by station_id, island_id, station_state

)

select
    md5(station_id || '|' || stockout_type || '|' || to_varchar(started_at)) as stockout_event_id,
    station_id,
    stockout_type,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    datediff('second', started_at, ended_at) / 60.0                  as duration_min,
    date_trunc('hour', started_at)                                   as hour_utc,
    is_ongoing,
    includes_stale_report,
    report_count
from episodes
where datediff('second', started_at, ended_at) / 60.0 >= 5

select stockout_event_id
from DIVVY.PROD_marts.fct_stockout_events
where stockout_event_id is null

select *
from DIVVY.PROD_marts.fct_stockout_events
where ended_at <= started_at

with all_values as (

    select
        stockout_type as value_field,
        count(*) as n_records

    from DIVVY.PROD_marts.fct_stockout_events
    group by stockout_type

)

select *
from all_values
where value_field not in (
    'empty','full'
)

select
    stockout_event_id as unique_field,
    count(*) as n_records

from DIVVY.PROD_marts.fct_stockout_events
where stockout_event_id is not null
group by stockout_event_id
having count(*) > 1

with child as (
    select station_id as from_field
    from DIVVY.PROD_marts.fct_stockout_events
    where station_id is not null
),

parent as (
    select station_id as to_field
    from DIVVY.PROD_marts.dim_station
)

select

        station_state,

        sum(iff(station_state <> 'out_of_service' and not is_stale, duration_min, 0)) as in_service_min,
        sum(iff(station_state = 'empty' and not is_stale, duration_min, 0))   as empty_min,

        sum(duration_min)                                                     as total_min,

        max(valid_from)                                                       as last_report_at
    from lagged
    group by station_id

),

episodes as (

)

select

    a.full_min  / nullif(a.in_service_min, 0)                                 as pct_time_full,
    a.stale_min / nullif(a.total_min, 0)                                      as pct_time_stale,

        when coalesce(e.empty_episodes, 0) + coalesce(e.full_episodes, 0)
             >= 20                              then 'repeat_stockout'
        else 'normal'

with intervals as (

    select station_id, valid_from, valid_to, station_state, is_stale, bikes_available
    from DIVVY.PROD_intermediate.int_station_status_intervals
    where valid_to > valid_from

),

split as (

    select
        i.station_id,
        dateadd('hour', h.value::int, date_trunc('hour', i.valid_from))        as hour_utc,
        datediff(
            'second',
            greatest(i.valid_from, dateadd('hour', h.value::int, date_trunc('hour', i.valid_from))),
            least(i.valid_to,      dateadd('hour', h.value::int + 1, date_trunc('hour', i.valid_from)))
        ) / 60.0                                                               as minutes,
        i.station_state,
        i.is_stale,
        i.bikes_available
    from intervals i,
         lateral flatten(input => array_generate_range(
             0, datediff('hour', date_trunc('hour', i.valid_from), i.valid_to) + 1)) h

),

agg as (

    select
        station_id,
        hour_utc,
        sum(minutes)                                                           as minutes_observed,
        sum(iff(not is_stale and station_state <> 'out_of_service', minutes, 0)) as minutes_in_service,
        sum(iff(not is_stale and station_state = 'empty', minutes, 0))         as minutes_empty,
        sum(iff(not is_stale and station_state = 'full',  minutes, 0))         as minutes_full,
        sum(iff(station_state = 'out_of_service', minutes, 0))                 as minutes_out_of_service,
        sum(iff(is_stale, minutes, 0))                                         as minutes_stale,
        sum(bikes_available * minutes) / nullif(sum(minutes), 0)               as avg_bikes,
        min(bikes_available)                                                   as min_bikes,
        max(bikes_available)                                                   as max_bikes
    from split
    where minutes > 0
    group by station_id, hour_utc

)
